title: qmutate: mutation testing for Qiskit quantum circuits
description: qmutate is a pre-alpha Python library for mutation testing of quantum circuits built with Qiskit. It removes one top-level instruction at a time from a circuit, runs a user-supplied test oracle against every mutant, and reports the outcomes and a mutation score. It also provides numerical equivalence checks for an equivalence-adjusted score and a finite-shot sampling oracle whose verdicts carry statistical guarantees under stated assumptions.
